recent.text: Hawks over the 3-game, 4-night homestand... +15.7 net rating with Dyson Daniels on court -33.3 net rating with Dyson Daniels off court
recent.author: Brad Rowland

recent.text: The Hawks won the rebounding battle (in decisive fashion) but had an uncharacterically poor night with ball security. 20 turnovers that led to 29 points.
recent.author: Brad Rowland
recent.quoted_text: The winning streak is over for the Hawks, as they dug a big hole in the 1st half and never fully climbed out of it on the way to a 10-point loss to LAL. Daniels, Okongwu, Johnson were all +5 or better, which kinda tells you how the bench minutes went. @LockedOnHawks to come.

recent.text: Lakers role players finished 12-24 from three. They will not lose often when that happens.

recent.text: Jock Landale, who is still wearing the mask following a nasal fracture earlier this season, just got popped in the face. Official review now for a potential hostile act.

recent.text: IMO Hawks need Daniels and Okongwu back in soon and for the duration of the evening.

recent.text: Jock Landale was immediately asking for a challenge on this out-of-bounds call and Quin Snyder obliges. On the first replay, it looks like Landale was right but TBD.
recent.author: Brad Rowland

recent.text: Hawks are challenging and I think they'll win it. Landale signaled that the ball went off a Laker shoulder, and review seemed to show exactly that.

recent.text: Hawks had an ugly first minute of the second half, but it's a 7-0 run since then, capped by a Dyson Daniels 3. ATL with 8 with 20+ min remaining.

recent.text: Great start to the 2H for the Hawks: a bad pass that leads to a Ziaire Williams dunk. Then Kingston Flemings leaves a layup short and it leads to another Ziaire Williams dunk...
